graphEvents.label: What each hop reads/emits and whether purpose travels
Continuity facets label next_safe_action as Goal
Resume signal has no purpose field

label: Claude's PreCompact hook reads only the transcript tail: active file paths, recent topics, attention signals and the last five meaningful lines plus a detected 'Active spec folder' path; it opens no packet document, so the packet arrives as a path string.
The continuity-aware compaction path is opt-in: authoredSnapshotEnabled requires input.authored_continuity_snapshot===true or continuity_snapshot==='authored', and default compaction does not set it.

Even on the continuity path the injected facets carry no purpose: the facet labelled 'Goal' is populated from next_safe_action, 'Decision' from answered-question ids, 'Progress' from recent_action plus touched files, 'Gotcha' from blockers and open questions.

session-prime emits pointers, not content: the startup fallback surface says continuity is recovered on demand from the packet docs, and after a compaction it prints 'Context was compacted. Run /speckit:resume ...'.

Neither runtime group recovers purpose: codex delegates to the Claude compact-inject adapter, dsh reuses the shared session-prime output plus the same recovery pointer, and pi/devin compose only the retained summary, an Active Spec Folder path and the recovery pointer; no hook outside claude imports the authored-snapshot module or calls the resume ladder.

/speckit:resume parses every tier into a fixed signal shape (summary, recentAction, nextSafeAction, blockers, keyFiles, documents, packetPointer) that has no purpose field; the handover tier reads only 'Recent action', 'Next safe action', 'Blockers' and 'Key files'.

The spec-docs fallback cannot recover purpose: it takes the title plus the first three non-heading, non-table lines as summary and synthesizes 'Review tasks.md and continue the packet.' as the next action, so the Problem & Purpose heading is filtered out.

The operator-facing resume brief has no purpose row (Spec, Confidence, Source, Now, Last confirmed, Next safe action, Blockers, Progress, Why this is next), and the restore panel feeding it is capped at 8 items / 1200 chars.

/speckit:handoff saves continuity then defers to /speckit:resume, and the handover template has no purpose heading; even an added purpose paragraph has no reader because the parser looks only for four labelled fields.

/speckit:save's writer contract is mechanics-only: recent_action and next_safe_action (<=96 chars, <=16 words), blockers and key_files (<=5 items), plus completion_pct and question lists; the thin record has no purpose field.

The deep-loop hop is the exception: the child-dispatch brief injects the full research_topic and the iteration prompt pack renders it with focus and remaining questions on every iteration, so research loops restate purpose by construction.
